preamble: Authority must be bounded, auditable, appealable, and repairable.

articles.I: Root authority exists only under constitutional constraint.
articles.II: Doctrine defines law but may not erase receipts.
articles.III: Enforcement may act only through authorized rules.
articles.V: Recovery may repair but may not rewrite history.
articles.VI: Appeals may challenge command, enforcement, audit, or recovery decisions.
articles.VII: Amendments require quorum, audit, and recorded legitimacy.
